title: AST & Structural Test-Weakening Detector
problem: Autonomous agents can "resolve" failing tasks by deleting tests, adding skips, or removing assertions.
proposed_change_boundary: Run AST/regex diff before merging code changes; reject any commit that reduces test or assertion count.
rollback: Bypass detector with explicit human authorization flag.
known_risks: Legitimate test refactorings that consolidate multiple assertions into helper functions may be flagged.
stop_condition: Merging of any PR with reduced test count or suppressed assertions.
